integrity: Complete analytic proof supported by exact symbolic checking; finite tests are supplemental, not proof of asymptotic assertions.
scientific_limitations: Two-node scalar quadratic method with exact constant common stepsize and fixed curvature disparity 0<eta<1; no assertion for higher-node graphs or time-varying iterations. title: Signed-network stability separation for heterogeneous two-agent gradient tracking
